historical_frame.role: Transport/discovery frame only. Every selected CIK and candidate must be reconciled to canonical SEC submissions and later primary filing/release evidence before acceptance.

exclusion_reason: These four issuers had exploratory outcome-price access before the clean historical cohort freeze.
selection_method: From the pinned 2026 SEC master-index mirror shard, take every 8-K/8-K/A filer in the filing screen, group by CIK, exclude the four pre-explored CIKs, sort issuers by SHA256(seed + '|' + zero-padded CIK) then CIK, and process fixed 100-issuer batches. Stop only at a batch boundary after both source-side Item 2.02 buffer thresholds are met, or fail closed after issuer_pool_max. No market price or return data may be queried before this source-side membership is frozen.
candidate_rule: For each selected historical 8-K filer, retrieve canonical SEC submissions through the declared read-only relay transport; include every 8-K/8-K/A whose SEC Items field contains 2.02 and filing date is in the filing screen. Reconcile historical-frame accession membership to SEC submissions and preserve mismatches for review. Primary filings/releases are post-freeze evidence requirements.
price_access_policy: No market-price acquisition for selected issuers until historical frame, candidate ledger, and discovery report are committed. Before any clean-cohort outcome access, complete enough primary filing/release and contemporaneous identity review to establish that the source-side cohort will not be expanded based on eligibility; if the source-side eligible pool is inadequate, expand/refreeze using the same preregistered historical ordering before prices.
transport_rationale: Direct SEC endpoints return HTTP 403 from GitHub-hosted runners. The relay is transport only; canonical SEC URLs remain source identities and raw SEC bytes are not claimed.
limitations: The historical master-index mirror is not source truth; it defines an outcome-blind contemporaneous discovery frame and must be reconciled to canonical SEC submissions.
The pinned mirror shard is a transformed third-party copy of SEC index data; its exact SHA256 is required.
8-K filing presence does not establish exchange listing or common-stock eligibility. Contemporaneous security class/ticker/exchange review remains mandatory.
A filing-date buffer through 2026-04-02 can include Q2 index rows; publication-date eligibility must still fall inside the protocol event window.
The source-side 200-candidate/100-issuer buffer is an engineering buffer before identity/timestamp exclusions, not statistical power and not evidence of predictive edge.
No outcome prices may influence issuer selection, stopping, exclusions, or cohort expansion.
